series.track: measured: beacon NEO-M9N GPS via the Pi tap line, 1 Hz, kept every 2 s (1 s within 60 s of touchdown)
series.track.vz, vh, hdg: computed: centred difference over +-10 s of 1 Hz GPS
series.track.dpad: computed: great-circle distance from the last pad fix, km
series.baro_out: measured: MS5611 outside the box; alt is the US Standard Atmosphere (1013.25 hPa), not GPS; c is the sensor's own temperature, not a calibrated air temperature
series.baro_in: measured: BMP280 inside the box; below 300 hPa it is outside its rated range
series.health: measured: Pi 5 every 10 s; soc C, cpu MHz, EXT5V V, vcgencmd get_throttled bits
series.wind: computed: balloon drift speed averaged in 500 m GPS-altitude bins; equals the wind only while the balloon moves with the air
series.gs: measured: ground Heltec receiver, one packet per 12 s
